title: Protection of initial NAS signalling messages

entities.name: Protection of initial NAS signalling messages
entities.description: Procedure for protecting initial NAS messages (REGISTRATION REQUEST, SERVICE REQUEST, CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST) using security contexts and ciphering of non-cleartext IEs.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for registration procedure. Contains cleartext and potentially non-cleartext IEs.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for service request procedure. Contains cleartext and potentially non-cleartext IEs.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for control plane service request. Contains cleartext IEs and optionally CIoT small data container or NAS message container.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message that is always sent unciphered.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: IE used to contain entire NAS messages (both cleartext and non-cleartext IEs) for protection.

entities.name: CIoT small data container
entities.description: IE used in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST for small data transmission, can be ciphered independently.

entities.name: UE has valid 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Condition where UE possesses an active 5G NAS security context for ciphering operations.

entities.name: UE does not have valid 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Condition where UE lacks an active 5G NAS security context, requiring cleartext-only transmission.

entities.name: UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs
entities.description: Condition where UE requires transmission of IEs that need ciphering protection.

entities.name: Security header type set to integrity protected
entities.description: Property where UE sets security header type to 'integrity protected' when including NAS message container IE.

entities.name: AMF deciphers NAS message container
entities.description: AMF behavior to decipher the value part of NAS message container IE upon reception.

entities.name: AMF deciphers CIoT small data container
entities.description: AMF behavior to decipher the value part of CIoT small data container IE in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

relations.description: Protection procedure applies to REGISTRATION REQUEST messages.
Protection procedure applies to SERVICE REQUEST messages.
Protection procedure applies to CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST messages.
REGISTRATION REQUEST can contain NAS message container IE for protected transmission.
SERVICE REQUEST can contain NAS message container IE for protected transmission.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST can contain NAS message container IE for protected transmission.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST can contain CIoT small data container IE for small data transmission.
Condition where non-cleartext IEs are needed triggers use of NAS message container.
When valid security context exists, NAS message container value part is ciphered.
When valid security context exists, CIoT small data container value part is ciphered.
When no valid security context exists, REGISTRATION REQUEST contains cleartext IEs only.
Inclusion of NAS message container IE requires security header type to be set to integrity protected.
AMF deciphers NAS message container IE upon reception in integrity protected initial NAS message.
AMF deciphers CIoT small data container IE upon reception in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is always sent unciphered.
